top_signals.title: Record US Stocks to Set Tone for Asia, Oil Gains: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian markets look poised to take their cue from Wall Street’s record-breaking rally as earnings take center stage, though elevated oil prices threaten to keep interest rates and global bond yields higher for longer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Meta may ditch the idea of a cloud business for Muse. We think that’s a good trade
top_signals.summary: We may never get the Meta Cloud business we once envisioned, but we don't need it if Muse delivers.
